headline: Northside Kings: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: Northside Kings is projected #15 of 16 with a 490.50 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Bhayshul Tuten, Mike Evans, and RJ Harvey. The immediate priority is improving the QB slot without weakening that core. On the Power Rankings webpage's D-AVI ladder, the franchise ranks #8 of 16 with a 168.0 team D-AVI score.

latest_trade.summary: On July 15, Northside Kings traded with Ravens Regime and acquired RJ Harvey, Bhayshul Tuten, 2026 Round 2 (Rapid Valley Annihilation) while sending Tyler Warren. RJ Harvey is now the current RB starter at 62.7 C-AVI and 81.6 D-AVI; Bhayshul Tuten is now the current RB starter at 73.1 C-AVI and 84.9 D-AVI; The deal added 1 draft asset.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the QB slot above Jordan Love's 51.2 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 99.3 C-AVI would directly attack the 48.10-point projected gap to Crimson Tide Pods.
Use draft capital as a targeted sweetener for a verified starting-lineup upgrade, not for additional bench depth.
